_comment: Phase 1 base pool (2026-06-11). Membership criterion is OBJECTIVE LIQUIDITY ONLY: US-listed common stocks among the largest/most-traded names (mega/large-cap, deep options/volume, tight spreads), sector-diverse. The trading universe is the top UNIVERSE_TOP_N of this pool by 6-1 momentum, recomputed weekly by rule (src/universe.py). NEVER add/remove names here based on how they performed in a backtest — that is exactly the survivorship bias this pool exists to kill.
